resources.string: Shows the Voxta dictation bubble only for focused, non-sensitive editable fields and inserts your transcript at the cursor. It never sends screen contents to Gemini.
Shown only while Voxta is using the microphone.
Start dictation. Long press for push to talk.
Voxta accessibility is limited to eligible editable fields and cursor insertion. Screen contents are not uploaded to Gemini.
Voxta does not continuously record audio. The microphone should be active only during a real dictation session.
The Voxta connection test is optional. Setup can finish without it.
